visual.general_description: Two side-by-side photographs, labelled A and B, of a person on a treadmill in front of a wall screen displaying a virtual road scene with a green shape in the foreground.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (left) shows a person from behind and the side with a green rectangular bar on the screen; panel B (right) shows a person from behind and the right with a green oval shape on the screen and parts of the laboratory room. In both panels the person wears a head cap, a harness with blue straps and black bands on the lower legs, and a translucent humanoid figure with arms outstretched appears in the virtual scene. Each photograph has a black frame with a white inner line and a bold panel letter above its upper left corner.

panels.general_description: Photograph taken from behind and slightly to the side of a person walking on a treadmill in front of a large wall screen that shows a virtual road scene. The person wears a head cap, a harness with blue straps, a pack on the back and black bands on the lower legs; the face is not visible. A green rectangular bar lies in the foreground of the virtual scene.
panels.detailed_description: The person stands on a dark treadmill belt with a pale handrail passing diagonally across the lower part of the frame. They wear a grey short-sleeved top with one shoulder bare, black shorts, a head cap with a dark ear piece, a harness with blue straps and buckles, a black pack at the waist, thin wires running down the legs, black bands on the lower legs and blue-and-white sneakers; one arm is bent forward and a dark band is visible on the wrist. The screen in front shows a three-dimensional road with a blue sky, a grey road with several yellow horizontal lines at different distances, a translucent humanoid figure with arms stretched out to the sides in the distance, small blue marks near its feet and a green rectangular bar in the foreground. A dark flat device sits on the floor below the screen on a green mat. A thin black border with a white inner line frames the photograph. No readable text or identifier is visible in this panel.
